"""Structured scenarios: rings, grids, parallel bundles, degenerate budgets."""
import json, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np
import check

reqs = []
# ring of 8 nodes, 8 edges, one commodity per pair
ring = [{"tail":i,"head":(i+1)%8,"capacity":10} for i in range(8)]
comps=[]
for s in range(8):
    for t in range(8):
        if s==t: continue
        # two ring paths
        p1=[]; n=s
        while n!=t: p1.append(n); n=(n+1)%8
        p1.append(t)
        e1=[i for i in range(8) if ring[i]["tail"]==p1[k] and ring[i]["head"]==p1[k+1]][0 for k in range(len(p1)-1)]
        p2=[]; n=s
        while n!=t: p2.append(n); n=(n-1)%8
        p2.append(t)
        e2=[i for i in range(8) if ring[i]["tail"]==p2[k] and ring[i]["head"]==p2[k+1]][0 for k in range(len(p2)-1)]
        comps.append({"source":s,"target":t,"demand":5,"paths":[e1,e2],"previous":[8,8]})
reqs.append({"epoch":100,"node_count":8,"edges":ring,"commodities":comps,"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
reqs.append({"epoch":101,"node_count":8,"edges":ring,"commodities":comps,"failed_edges":[0],"budget":1000})
reqs.append({"epoch":102,"node_count":8,"edges":ring,"commodities":comps,"failed_edges":[0],"budget":0})
# grid 4x4
grid=[]; idx={}
n=0
for r in range(4):
    for c in range(4):
        idx[(r,c)]=n; n+=1
for r in range(4):
    for c in range(4):
        if c<3: grid.append({"tail":idx[(r,c)],"head":idx[(r,c+1)],"capacity":7})
        if r<3: grid.append({"tail":idx[(r,c)],"head":idx[(r+1,c)],"capacity":9})
gc=[]
for (r,c) in idx:
    if c<3:
        gc.append({"source":idx[(r,c)],"target":idx[(r,c+1)],"demand":3,"paths":[[len(grid)-1]],"previous":[16]})
gc=[c for c in gc]
reqs.append({"epoch":103,"node_count":16,"edges":grid,"commodities":gc,"failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# parallel bundle with 16 identical paths
bundle=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":3} for _ in range(16)]
reqs.append({"epoch":104,"node_count":2,"edges":bundle,
             "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":20,"paths":[[i] for i in range(16)],"previous":[1]*16}],
             "failed_edges":[],"budget":100})
# budget exactly equal to the required migration
reqs.append({"epoch":105,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":30},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":30}],
             "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":20,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
             "failed_edges":[0],"budget":20})
# zero demand everything
reqs.append({"epoch":106,"node_count":3,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5},{"tail":1,"head":2,"capacity":5}],
             "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":2,"demand":0,"paths":[[0,1]],"previous":[16]}],
             "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})

data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
if p.stderr: print("stderr:",p.stderr.decode()[-1000:])
for req,line in zip(reqs,p.stdout.decode().splitlines()):
    resp=json.loads(line); d=check.build(req)
    errs=check.check(req,resp)
    extra=""
    if resp["status"]=="optimal":
        y=np.array(resp["dual"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["dual"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        extra="viol=%.3g |y|=%.4g mlu=%.8g mig=%.6g"%(float((acc-d["c"]).max()),np.abs(y).max(),resp["mlu"],resp["migration"])
    else:
        y=np.array(resp["certificate"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["certificate"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        val=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+(float(d["b_eq"].dot(q)) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        extra="viol=%.3g |y|=%.4g norm=%.12g"%(float(acc.max()),np.abs(y).max(),val)
    print("%-6s %-11s %-40s %s"%(req["epoch"],resp["status"],extra,errs if errs else "OK"))
PYEOF
